notes: This contract records the provider- and FOM-independent C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 NullFederateAmbassador callback surface. It invokes every standard no-op callback family and each standard ordinary/timestamped overload that the portable test depends on. It is an API contract check only and does not claim provider behavior or cross-RTI interoperability.

api_surfaces.signature: NullFederateAmbassador callback families and standard overloads
